how_to_update: A mentor or clinician can change any 'expected' value (high, medium, low) and set rated_by to their name. lib/grading/answer-key.test.ts then holds the engine to their ratings.

scale.high: Same kind of broken protein in the same place; a therapy or study design could plausibly transfer.
scale.medium: Same broad kind of protein but a different place or job; some shared research questions.
scale.low: Same disease family only (lipofuscin storage), different kind of protein; therapies do not transfer directly.
